citations.assessment: In the sequence of eulogies, the case explicitly names Oshaya of Tirya, the flying bier, and the verse from Song of Songs. The midrash applies it to the love shown by God.
The named successor on the day Rabbi Avin died is Abba Hoshaya of Traya. The genre and attributed verse are those of a succession homily.

The located Midrash Shmuel text has “Rabbi Hoshaya his son.” The older Yuchasin witness and Heilprin name Rabbi Yehoshua his son. Distinguish the two names and keep the kinship language attached to each witness.
The succession unit has Rabbi Hoshaya at the death of Abba Hoshaya, with no “his son” in this specific clause. It does use the patronym expression in an earlier pair.
